name: rubi
description: Persistent markdown memory for Claude Desktop: save where you left off and continue in a fresh chat without losing the thread.
long_description: Keeps notes and handoffs in a markdown vault (opens in Obsidian). When a chat gets long, Claude saves a handoff and you continue in a new chat, spending far less of your usage limit.

tools.name: rubi_contexto
tools.description: Search knowledge (text + graph) within a token budget

tools.name: rubi_registrar
tools.description: Store decisions, concepts, preferences as graph nodes

tools.name: rubi_mapa
tools.description: Overview of everything stored for a project

vault.title: Vault folder
vault.description: Where notes are stored (an Obsidian vault works). Leave empty to use ~/rubi-vault.
